strategies.name: Dip in an uptrend
strategies.why: A strong, rising stock has fallen sharply for 2-3 days. Such short dips in leading stocks usually bounce back within days.
strategies.exit: Sell when the price closes above its 5-day average (usually 3-7 days), or at the stop-loss, or after 10 trading days, whichever comes first.

strategies.name: Breakout with volume
strategies.why: The stock just made a new 50-day high on 1.5x normal volume and is one of the strongest 30% in the market. Big buyers are often behind such moves.
strategies.exit: Sell at the target, or if the trailing stop is hit (it rises as the price rises), or after 30 trading days.

strategies.name: Bounce from support
strategies.why: A stock in a healthy uptrend pulled back to its 20-day average (a common support level) and closed strongly higher today.
strategies.exit: Sell at the target (2x the risk), at the stop-loss, or after 20 trading days.
